title: Ethyl caffeate combined with fluconazole exhibits efficacy against azole-resistant oropharyngeal candidiasis via the EFGR/JNK/c-JUN signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Tianming; Pan, Min; Bao, Mengyuan; Bu, Qingru; Yang, Ruotong; Yang, Yue; Shao, Jing; Wang, Changzhong; Li, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究咖啡酸乙酯联合氟康唑抗耐药念珠菌口咽感染的药效与EGFR/JNK/c-JUN信号通路机制，仅涉及分子对接EGFR，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ethyl caffeate (EC) is a phenylpropanoid compound derived from Elephantopus scaber. In our previous work, EC was investigated to have a strong synergistic antifungal effect against azole-resistant strains of Candida albicans when combined with fluconazole (FLU). However, the protective effect and mechanism of EC + FLU on oropharyngeal candidiasis (OPC) caused by drug-resistant strains of C. albicans have not been investigated. This study aimed to investigate the protective effect and mechanism of EC combined with FLU against C. albicans-resistant strains that lead to OPC. An OPC mouse model revealed that EC + FLU treatment reduced fungal load and massive hyphal invasion of tongue tissues, and ameliorated the integrity of the tongue mucosa. Periodic acid-Schiff staining results showed more structural integrity of the tongue tissues and reduced inflammatory cell infiltration after EC + FLU treatment. Phosphorylation of EGFR (epidermal growth factor receptor) and other proteins in the EFGR/JNK (c-Jun N-terminal kinase)/c-JUN (transcription factor Jun) signaling pathway was significantly downregulated by EC + FLU. EGFR and S100A9 mRNA expression were also reduced. The above results were verified in FaDu cells. ELISA results showed that the concentration of inflammatory factors in the cell supernatant was significantly reduced after EC combined with FLU treatment. Molecular docking revealed that EC exhibited high binding energy to EGFR. In conclusion, EC enhances the susceptibility of azole-resistant C. albicans to FLU, and the underlying mechanism is related to the inhibition of the EGFR/JNK/c-JUN signaling pathway. This result suggests that EC has potential to be developed as an antifungal sensitizer to treat OPC caused by azole-resistant C. albicans.
abstract_zh: 咖啡酸乙酯（EC）是一种源自地胆草（Elephantopus scaber）的苯丙素类化合物。在我们先前的工作中，研究发现EC与氟康唑（FLU）联合使用时，对耐唑类药物的白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）菌株具有强协同抗真菌作用。然而，EC + FLU对由耐药白色念珠菌菌株引起的口咽念珠菌病（OPC）的保护作用及其机制尚未被研究。本研究旨在探讨EC联合FLU对导致OPC的耐药白色念珠菌菌株的保护作用及机制。OPC小鼠模型显示，EC + FLU处理降低了真菌负荷和舌组织中大量菌丝侵袭，并改善了舌黏膜的完整性。高碘酸-雪夫染色结果显示，EC + FLU处理后舌组织结构更完整，炎症细胞浸润减少。EC + FLU显著下调了EGFR（表皮生长因子受体）及EGFR/JNK（c-Jun N末端激酶）/c-JUN（转录因子Jun）信号通路中其他蛋白的磷酸化。EGFR和S100A9 mRNA表达也降低。上述结果在FaDu细胞中得到验证。ELISA结果显示，EC联合FLU处理后，细胞上清液中炎症因子浓度显著降低。分子对接显示，EC与EGFR具有高结合能。总之，EC增强了耐唑类白色念珠菌对FLU的敏感性，其潜在机制与抑制EGFR/JNK/c-JUN信号通路有关。这一结果表明，EC有潜力被开发为抗真菌增敏剂，用于治疗由耐唑类白色念珠菌引起的OPC。
